contexts.text: There is a capacious lake towards the left, in a plane with the lower parts of the body, greater in length than in breadth. Near its front bank there appear... monstrous serpents, such as are in standing waters... On the left bank... appear those who devour human flesh, and each other... Further on to the left there appear great fishes, monstrous whales, which swallow men and vomit them up again. On the opposite bank there appear very deformed faces, especially those of old women... who run about as if they were insane. On the right bank are those who try to kill each other with cruel instruments... In the middle of the lake it is everywhere black, like what has stagnated. I have occasionally seen some brought to this lake... who were such as had cherished intestine hatred against the neighbour... SE 1379.
They who have practised robberies, and piracy... seem to themselves to dwell in filthily stinking lakes.
A city between Gehenna and the Lake where the better Jews seem to themselves to dwell... SE 747.
They who have been delighted with mere pleasures... dwell in urinous and stinking lakes.
They who are tenacious of revenge... are conveyed into a miry lake, which is near the filthy Jerusalem, and are rolled and dipped therein, so that they become like mire...
Such Spirits desire nothing more than to pass their time in things stagnant, miry, and excrementitious...
It appears as if they were cast down, some towards the Lake...
The devil was cast into a lake of fire and brimstone...
And upon their pools () = into the scientifics which serve... truths... or falsities.

Pools, in the Word... = intelligence from the Knowledges of good and truth; for pools there mean collected waters or lakes, (which) = Knowledges in the complex through which is intelligence. Illustrated.
To set the wilderness for a pool of waters () = to give the Knowledges of good and truth, and the derivative intelligence, where they were not before.
Pools of soul () = the things which are of intelligence from Knowledges...

That pools of waters, in the opposite sense, = evils from falsities, and the derivative insanity. Illustrated. They also = the Hell where such things reign, but in this case the pool is called a pool (or lake) of fire...
Upon the streams, upon the rivers, and upon the pools () = against falsities.
Around those who are in truths, and not from good, there appear nothing but rocks, crags, and pools... But around those who are in falsities from evil there appear marshes...
Some (of the openings to the Hells appear) like marshes; and some like pools of water...
The evil are cast into marshes and pools.
The concupiscences of evil together with their delights then remain with them, like impure waters stopped up and stagnated.
The general delight in Hell is smelled as stagnated water, into which have been thrown various kinds of filth...
When we sank down, the place at first appeared to us like a lake, but presently like dry land, and afterwards like a small city...

The lake of fire burning with brimstone () = the Hell where are they who are in the loves of that falsity, and at the same time in the cupidities of evil. By a lake is signified falsities in abundance.

The Hell where such are, appears from afar like a fiery lake with a green flame as of brimstone. But those who are therein do not see this... It is their love of falsity, together with the cupidities of evil, which makes the appearance of such a lake.
That by a lake is signified where there is truth in abundance; and thence, in the opposite sense, where there is falsity in abundance. Illustrated.
By the lake of fire into which he was cast () is signified the Hell where are the loves of falsity and the cupidities of evil.

And death and Hell were cast into the lake of fire () = that the impious at heart... were cast down into Hell among those who were in the love of evil, and thence in the love of the falsity which agrees with evil.
A lake = where there is falsity in abundance. AR 874.
Their part is in the lake of fire burning with brimstone () = the Hell for them where are the loves of falsity and the cupidities of evil.
These shun extra-conjugial loves... as the lakes of Hell.
Lakes (seen), out of which crocodiles raised their heads.
They are cast into the gulfs of the west, which from afar appear like lakes of fire and sulphur.

I looked at the end of the west, and lo there appeared as it were lakes of fire and sulphur; and I asked the Angel why the Hells there appear so. He replied. They appear as lakes, from falsifications of truth, because water, in the spiritual sense, is truth; and there appears as it were fire about them and in them, from the love of evil; and as it were sulphur, from the love of falsity. These three things = the lake, the fire, and the sulphur, are appearances, because they are correspondences of the evil loves in which they are. All there are shut up in eternal workhouses...
The Angel opened the Hell in the western quarter... and said, Look there. And they saw a lake as it were fiery, and recognized there some who had been their friends in the world...

The next day... I saw that the forest had disappeared, and in its place there was a sandy plain, and in the middle of it a lake, in which were some red serpents... But some weeks afterwards... I saw on its right side some fallow land...
The World of Spirits is as full of the wicked... as a viridescent pond is of the spawn of frogs.
If charity is without truths, (it is like) a man eating burnt bread, and at the same time drinking unclean water from some pond.
That they might look into the sea, which is a lake.
The sea which is called a lake, is the penalty of those who oppose themselves to heavenly truth...
They seem to live in lakes (of urine, etc.).
On the Lake. General article.
On those who are at the right of the Lake...
On the penalties of those who relate to the stagnant humours in the brain.

He (then) falls downwards into a black and very filthy lake, and there remains until he is liberated by the Lord. The water is so filthily black that it can scarcely be described. Such falls frequently take place; for thus Heaven is freed from Falsities. But when they have been instructed in the World of Spirits... they are again received. SE 2831.
Thus they were immersed in their lakes.
On a poisoner, who was cast into a lake... He said that it was excrementitious and filthy. SE 3562. SE 3564.

They returned through caverns towards the lake, so that I supposed that they would advance beneath the lake; but their cavernous way was bent... to the limits of this universe, and where there before appeared as it were a stagnant sea, into which they were cast in another universe...
When anyone supposes himself to be greater than others... he is transferred far to the left... where there appears a lake smoking with fire...
Elsewhere, also, there are smoking lakes... for filthy adulterers... (and) for the cruel.
Around the cities, and elsewhere, there appear marshes or lakes.
Above a lake at the right side, which no one can pass over without being suffocated.
There was a marsh near, or an utterly marshy water, a lake...
On gulfs which are also Hell; lakes of sulphur.
On the casting of Babel into the lake of sulphur.
They who were carried away into the lakes were carried away in a moment.

This shining lake appeared (so) from the sulphureousness of lasciviousness. Into this lake all the women were cast. The lake was situated transversely at the end of the angle; it was great; and a great number were cast into it...
(The position of this lake shown by a diagram.)
All these were cast into their lake...
They were cast down; very many into marshes and lakes...
A pool of waters, and a spring of waters () = good, because there is truth; for all spiritual good... is procured through truths.
A pool of waters () = an abundance of truth.
A pool of waters () = the Knowledges of truth; and a fountain of waters = the Word from which they are. ( = truths in abundance. AE 483:6.)

I will dry up the pools ()... The pools = the perception of truth. The understanding of truth is from the light of truth, but the perception of truth is from the heat or love of truth. ( = that the Knowledge of truth will perish. AE 518:31.)
A pool of waters, etc. () = an abundance of the Knowledges of truth.
It is from the signification of waters, as being truths, that a fountain = the Word, and the doctrine of truth; and that pools, lakes, and seas = the Knowledges of truth in the complex.
That then there will be intelligence through Divine spiritual truth with those with whom before there was not any, is signified by The dry place shall be for a pool (). AE 714:15.
Truths in abundance in the spiritual man, are meant by a pool of waters (); and truths in abundance in the natural man, by springs of waters. AE 730:25.
Such are carried to the boundaries of the Spiritual World of our Earth, where there appears a lake smoking with fire...
Harlots... cast into a marshy lake... DeConj 92.
The ancients called these Hells... the pools of Acheron.
